_comment: Wire the screensaver into Noctalia's IdleService. Open ~/.config/noctalia/settings.json, find the 'idle' object, and merge these fields. The customCommands array already exists (default '[]'); add an entry like the one below.

idle._lockTimeout_comment: Set lockTimeout to your desired total idle-to-lock seconds; Noctalia's native ext-session-lock-v1 lock will overlay the screensaver when this fires.
idle._screenOff_comment: Use Noctalia's screen-off (DPMS via niri) for the deeper idle stage.
